name: CRUZR S2
name_zh: CRUZR S2 全尺寸轮式人形机器人
summary:
CRUZR S2 is UBTECH's full-size wheeled humanoid for mobile manipulation and customized services. Its body combines lifting and bending with a mobile base, allowing the arms to work over a range of heights and turn within constrained passages. The manufacturer describes a 15 kg handling capability within the specified workspace.

Industrial dexterous hands and an embodied-intelligence development system support applications such as sorting, assembly-related work and grasping different objects. The platform connects mobility with fine manipulation, allowing it to move between task locations. Pre

description.en:
CRUZR S2 is UBTECH's full-size wheeled humanoid for mobile manipulation and customized services. Its body combines lifting and bending with a mobile base, allowing the arms to work over a range of heights and turn within constrained passages. The manufacturer describes a 15 kg handling capability within the specified workspace.

Industrial dexterous hands and an embodied-intelligence development system support applications such as sorting, assembly-related work and grasping different objects. The platform connects mobility with fine manipulation, allowing it to move between task locations. Precision claims and workload limits depend on the specific configuration, object and operating conditions.
